APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS
LISTED UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers on items that are
not listed on the agenda. Any public comments that cannot be heard within the next 20
minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. If a member of the public wishes to speak
on a Consent Calendar item, the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar for
separate discussion and to allow the member of the public to speak on the Consent
Calendar item at that time. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or
other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  JOINT REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL AND THE ARTESIA
  HOUSING AUTHORITY

  MONDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2020
  7:00 P.M.
The Joint Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council and the Artesia Housing Authority was
called to order at 7:00 p.m., on Monday, February 10, 2020 in the Artesia City Council
Chambers by Mayor Ali Taj. The Invocation was presented by Councilmember Lima. The
Pledge of Allegiance was led by Beautification and Maintenance Chairperson, Kathy Harrison.

PRESENT:  Ali Taj, Mayor
  Rene Trevino, Mayor Pro Tem
  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, Interim City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistant City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Fiona Graham, Planning Manager
  Siamlu Cox, Acting Finance Manager
  Boyd Horan, Human Resources Manager
  Rosa Pinuelas, Parks and Recreation Manager
  Okina Dor, Planning Director
  Karen Lee, Management Analyst
  Jeremy Bates, Management Analyst
  Andrea Mejia, Management Analyst

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS

  City Clerk presented the announcement.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS THAT ARE NOT ON THE AGENDA OR ITEMS LISTED
UNDER THE HEADING CONSENT CALENDAR

  Margaret Saito, resident, provided public comments on items not on the agenda.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  1
   Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1. PRESENTATION OF A CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO ENERGY UPGRADE
  CALIFORNIA

  Mayor Taj presented Laura Rosenthal, Energy Upgrade California with a Certificate of
  Recognition.

  2. CHECK PRESENTATION FROM THE ARTESIA CHAMBER OF COMMERCE

  City Council received a Check Presentation from the Artesia Chamber of Commerce.

BUSINESS PRESENTATIONS

  3. PRESENTATION BY ENERGY UPGRADE CALIFORNIA

  Laura Rosenthal, Energy Upgrade California, presented to the City Council

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

CONSENT CALENDAR (ITEM NOS. 4-12)

  Councilmember Canales pulled Item No. 9 for discussion.

  Councilmember Ramoso pulled Item No. 8 for discussion.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR
  WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ITEM NOS. 8 and 9, which were pulled for discussion, and
  Item No. 12, for which there was a speaker card.

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  Said motion carried (5-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Lima, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

ITEM NO. 8 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  Councilmember Ramoso requested a Staff Report from City Manager Rawlings

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  Councilmember Ramoso requested that Staff add a definition of climate change to the
  glossary of the Emergency Operations Plan, and address the impact of the impending
  train project on the transportation component of the Emergency Operations Plan.

  2
   MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  Said motion carried (5-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Lima, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

ITEM NO. 9 WAS PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

  Councilmember Canales requested a Staff Report from City Manager Rawlings.

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES TO RECEIVE AND FILE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ITEM NO. 12 WAS PULLED FOR PUBLIC COMMENTS

  Margaret Saito, resident, provided comments to the City Council.

  MOTION BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO TO APPROVE THE ITEM

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA

  City Council Action: The item was approved without objection 5-0-0.

ORDINANCES

  13. CONSIDERATION AND INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 20-891, AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA TO ADOPT UPDATED LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY BUILDING, ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, MECHANICAL, RESIDENTIAL,
  GREEN BUILDING STANDARDS, AND EXISTING BUILDING CODES WHICH
  INCORPORATE AND AMEND THE 2019 CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA THAT THE CITY COUNCIL WAIVE FULL
  READING AND INTRODUCE, AS READ BY TITLE ONLY, ORDINANCE NO. 20-891,
  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING BY
  REFERENCE TITLE 26 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING
  AND AMENDING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA BUILDING CODE; TITLE 27 OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2019
  CALIFORNIA ELECTRICAL CODE; TITLE 28 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA PLUMBING
  CODE; TITLE 29 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND
  AMENDING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA MECHANICAL CODE; TITLE 30 OF THE LOS

   ANGELES COUNTY CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2019
  CALIFORNIA RESIDENTIAL CODE; TITLE 31 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA GREEN
  BUILDING STANDARDS CODE; TITLE 33 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE,
  INCORPORATING AND AMENDING THE 2019 CALIFORNIA EXISTING BUILDING
  CODE; AND THE 2019 CALIFORNIA FIRE CODE; TOGETHER WITH CERTAIN
  AMENDMENTS, DELETIONS AND ADDITIONS, INCLUDING FINDINGS, FEES AND

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO

  Said motion carried (5-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales, Lima, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

 14. CONSIDERATION OF AND INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING CHAPTER 2 (“FIREWORKS”) OF TITLE 4
  (“PUBLIC SAFETY”) OF THE ARTESIA MUNICIPAL CODE, LIMITING THE
  DISCHARGE PERIOD OF SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report.

  Councilmember Ramos provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO NOT ADOPT ORDINANCE NO. 20-890, AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING CHAPTER 2
  (“FIREWORKS”) OF TITLE 4 (“PUBLIC SAFETY”) OF THE ARTESIA MUNICIPAL
  CODE, LIMITING THE DISCHARGE PERIOD OF SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  Said motion carried (3-2-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Canales
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  Vic Norcia, resident, provided public comments.

COUNCILMEMBER/STAFF INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

 15. COUNCILMEMBER’S REPORTING ON EXTERNAL BOARDS AND COMMITTEE
  MEETINGS ATTENDED

  4
   Councilmember Lima reported on the Council of Government’s (COG) meeting.

  Councilmember Canales requested a report from the Interim City Attorney on SB 50.

  Interim City Attorney provided a report.

  Mayor Taj reported on the Eco-Rapid Transit meeting.

 16. COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS ON MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE

  Councilmember Ramoso reported on League of California Cities New Mayor and
  Councilmember Academy.

  Mayor Taj reported on League of California Cities meeting.

 17. CITY MANAGER INFORMATION BRIEF

  City Manager Rawlings provided a report on the following items: The City applied for and
  was approved for a SB 2 planning grant in the amount of $160,000. In a continued effort
  to mitigate carbon by planting trees, the City is applying for a grant to plant an additional
  500 trees to be planted in the public right of way, as well as made available to the public
  for planting. There will be another alley cleanup in March. Staff has interacted with six
  homeless individuals in the City, and four were willing and accepted services.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments.

  Mayor Taj provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting at 8:22 pm.
